laptop, commander · fleets home (default), work ·
  no app checkout here → fleet home (commander.default_fleet)

The hub namespace acts on this machine directly. It is never
forwarded to a daemon and caramelod refuses it over the SSH API.

Every machine starts as a hub of one, so these are also what a member types
about itself: 'hub status' and 'hub uninstall' answer for the box you are on.

Usage:
  caramelo hub [flags]
  caramelo hub [command]

Examples:
  caramelo hub setup --target you@box
  caramelo hub status
  caramelo hub probe box
  sudo caramelo hub uninstall --yes


Available Commands:
  probe       Ask whether a machine's tunnel port answers from here
  setup       Turn this machine into a Caramelo host (run as root)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for hub

Global Flags:
      --fleet string      fleet to talk to, by its name in the commander config (default: the app's fleet, then the default fleet)
      --json              print machine-readable JSON on stdout
      --machine string    raw ssh target to talk to, for a machine that is in no fleet yet: user@host[:port], or 'local'
      --progress string   how progress is written to stderr: text (default) or json, one event per line

Use "caramelo hub [command] --help" for more information about a command.

2 commands are hidden here; 'caramelo manual --role all' lists every command of every role.
